points: Today, we’re excited to announce the availability of Claude Haiku 5.5 on Amazon Bedrock and Claude Platform on AWS .
According to Anthropic, Claude Haiku 5.5 is the fastest and most efficient model in the Claude 5.5 family, built for subagents and high-volume, cost-sensitive work.
It also costs around 75 percent less than Claude Haiku 4.5 for most tasks.
